====================
line and block comments
====================

-- A leading line comment
CREATE SCHEMA demo; -- trailing comment
/* A block
   comment */
CREATE TYPE demo.item AS OBJECT (
    name TEXT NOT NULL /* inline */ 
);

---

(source_file
  (comment)
  (create_schema_statement
    (kw_create)
    (kw_schema)
    name: (qualified_name
      (identifier))
    (semicolon))
  (comment)
  (comment)
  (create_type_statement
    (create_object_type_statement
      (kw_create)
      (kw_type)
      name: (qualified_name
        (identifier)
        (dot)
        (identifier))
      (kw_as)
      (kw_object)
      (lparen)
      (field_definition
        name: (identifier)
        type: (type_spec
          (scalar_type
            (kw_text)))
        (kw_not)
        (kw_null))
      (comment)
      (rparen)
      (semicolon))))
